zhao22.role: M1 code identical to vendored experiment/code/zhao22

deeprehabpile.role: M4 LITEMV / M5 ConvTran (PREREG_R7_amend1); github.com/MSD-IRIMAS/DeepRehabPile, pip -e into env deeprehabpile

amend1.spec: PREREG_R7_amend1.md (md5 in prereg, pre-run stamp R0_stamp_amend1.json in stamps)
amend1.model_selection: benchmark default: ModelCheckpoint(monitor='loss', save_best_only) -> prediction with the lowest TRAINING-loss checkpoint; differs in wording from PREREG_R7's 'last epoch' for M1-M3' but involves no test data (recorded here as the amendment requires)
amend1.ensemble: 5 initializations per run unit, probability averaging; initialization i of run seed s uses tf.keras.utils.set_random_seed(5*s + i)
amend1.input_view: (100,19,3) -> (19,3,100) -> deep_rehab_pile.utils._normalize_skeletons (per-dimension min-max fit on the training persons of that action) -> (57,100) channels-first, as load_classification_data
amend1.env_note: env deeprehabpile pinned per the repo README (tensorflow 2.16.1, keras 3.6.0, aeon 1.2.0, numpy 1.26.4, scikit-learn 1.4.2, hydra-core 1.3.2, omegaconf 2.3.0, pandas 2.0.3, matplotlib 3.9.0); pyproject.toml at the recorded commit declares tensorflow>=2.18 / aeon==1.4.0 / numpy>=2 instead, so the package was installed with `pip install -e . --no-deps`. The estimator code is identical at both requirement sets (only pyproject/dockerfile/tests changed after v0.1.2).

m3_fallback.decision: M3' Kelly510/RehabExerAssess used instead of M3 EvenGu/ExeChecker
m3_fallback.reason: ExeChecker @1e6df14 cannot run as shipped: trainMulti_perExe.py imports train_val_test.parser_args, loss.hierarchical_loss, joints_dtw — none in repo; and the shipped model returns (features, embeddings) only — no code path produces a per-rep scalar error score (p(error)), which PREREG_R7 requires. Both activation conditions in the prereg are met.

m2_budget_decision.measured: 3 concurrent M2 processes per V100 (memory growth on): no process reached epoch 100 within 35 min after epoch 1 (14:10:51 -> 14:45:47), i.e. > 21 s/epoch shared, > 7 s/epoch per GPU at 99% util; 1000 epochs > 1.9 GPU-h per run; 24 runs > 46 GPU-h. Earlier uncontended attempt (1 process per GPU): epoch 100 not reached within 5.8 min -> > 3.5 s/epoch -> > 58 min per run, 24 runs > 23 GPU-h.
m2_budget_decision.rule: PREREG_R7: total projected > 24 GPU-hours -> seeds reduced to 1

decision.layout: seed0 S1 folds 0-3 on GPU0 (V0=100), seed0 S2 folds 0-3 on GPU1 (V0=110)

m2_budget_decision.aborted: partial M2 runs v111,v121,v131,v141,v151 (seeds 1,2 and the GPU0 copy of seed0 S2) killed before finishing and their empty run dirs removed; launcher logs kept in aborted_logs/
m2_budget_decision.layout_final: seed0: 8 runs launched as 8 concurrent single-run processes at 14:49 (S1 folds 0-3 on GPU0 = v101-v104, S2 folds 0-3 on GPU1 = v111-v114), TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true; the two sequential chains started 14:02/14:46 were stopped first and their partial v101/v111 dirs removed (no scores produced).

measured_m4.unit: M4 S1 fold 0 seed 0 (3 actions x 5 initializations, 1500 epochs each)
measured_m4.conditions: measured while several run_split processes shared the V100s (see log timestamps / SESSION_STATE_amend1.txt); contended, so per-unit time is an upper bound of the uncontended time

m4m5_budget_decision.rule: PREREG_R7_amend1: M4 + M5 projected > 24 GPU-hours -> seeds reduced to {0}, else {0,1,2}

launch_decision.basis: taken before the measured pilot unit finished, from the 50-epoch extrapolation recorded under pilot.json['amend1'] (smoke_amend1/timing.json)

prior.reason: seeds=3 estimate 178.6 GPU-h > 24 -> seeds=1 per prereg budget rule; even seeds=1 est 59.5 GPU-h exceeds 24 - reported, no further lever exists in prereg

m4m5_budget_decision.note: GPU-hours = run units x measured unit wall time, as for the M1/M2 decisions; measured under GPU sharing. If 'consistent' were false the matrix would have to be extended to seeds 1, 2.

void_rules.reason: score saturation: score_items computed 1 - exp(logp[c] - lse) in float, which with the model's large logits collapses to exactly 0 or 1 (1-3 unique score values per action), so AUC was dominated by ties. Fixed in commit c902914 (within-action log-odds in log space, a strictly monotone transform of the pre-registered 1 - p(correct); pred unchanged). These runs also have the batch-1 BatchNorm defect below. The whole M1 matrix was re-run.

inference ran with BatchNorm skipped: score_items fed one rep at a time and zhao22/models.py GCN_class.forward guards both BatchNorm1d layers with `if b > 1`, while the repo tests with batch_size=len(data_test). On un-normalized activations |log p| ~ 1e4 (root cause of the saturation) and S0 12-class accuracy was 0.25/0.36 (seed 0/1) vs 0.875/0.920 with full-batch inference on the same trained models. Fixed in commit 89d7974 (one batch per condition, score/pred formulas unchanged) and the whole M1 matrix was re-run.
